essence: The prescribed mixture consists of black gram, pigeon pea, lentils, chickpea, and grains combined together.
When cooked in pungent oil, the mixture becomes the supreme ritual cake.
Only liquor and spirituous liquor are permitted, and no other liquid should be used.
The preparation should be kept in water until it becomes sour.
This cake gives great satisfaction to the śaktis.
